features: ODT/OTT read, structured ODT creation and exact supported text revision
PPTX/POTX/PPSX/ODP/OTP/FODP native profile operations and exact supported text revision
ODP/OTP/FODP selected-slide merge with compatible global resources and title-source metadata
reviewer_fixes: Exclude noncontent text and typed/repeated ODF cell text
Preserve nonselected native XML on text edits
Serialize lexical QName namespaces independently of process-global registry
Bound namespace expansion before retaining output XML
limits: Selected plain ODF text and equally formatted OOXML runs only; unsupported fields/links/mixed formatting refuse.
Merge requires two distinct sources and compatible global styles/settings; unsupported relationships/active content refuse.
Cross-family rendering and full visual fidelity remain untested.
ODS and RTF are separate later source work, absent from this patch.
